A small '''sect''' of members of the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]]<ref name="ARCH" /> [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Chevin}}</ref> existed<ref name="ARCH" /> by [[3646 BBY]].<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates/1|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Pilgrimage" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. Furthermore, as the sect visits the [[Unidentified blue sun|blue sun]] every three years, they existed by at least [[3646 BBY]].</ref> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the sect made a pilgrimage to a nameless [[Unidentified blue sun|blue sun]] for an ancient ritual, a tradition they upheld every three years. The pilgrim sect possessed an [[Chevin pilgrim stronghold|ancient stronghold]] and a [[Chevin pilgrim idol|sacred idol]], the latter of which had certain practices related to it.<ref name="ARCH" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the two warring governments in the ongoing [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] had a companion of theirs follow the sect on their pilgrimage to learn their history. The Chevin welcomed the companion and at the end of the pilgrimage showed them into the stronghold, where the sect instructed them in the idol's ways and offered aid.<ref name="ARCH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Chevin sect was mentioned in the Crew Skill Mission "Pilgrimage" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="ARCH" />
